annotations.title: About this server: coverage and counts

description: What this server holds: how many published items each publication has, the date range each covers, when the VI Update and Good Day data were last refreshed, how each publication is credited, and what is not included; also every published Paper by id, with its date, version, DOI and license. Use for questions about scope, or before reading an empty search as a gap in coverage.
